Thadrion is a black drakonid located in the Onyx Laboratory in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible. He is one of The Forgotten Experiments, created by Neltharion 20,000 years ago in his attempts to create ideal soldiers for the War of the Scaleborn. He was the 147th prototype created and was imbued with excess arcane power that earlier attempts lacked. However, this led to unstable arcane surges that rendered him "useless". Additionally, he appears highly mutated, with large stretches of exposed flesh and notably erratic behavior. But he was also deemed too dangerous to destroy, and was sealed in stasis until being released by the Echo of Neltharion to test several intruders.

The Thalassian army is the armed forces of the kingdom of Quel'Thalas under the command of Ranger-General Halduron Brightwing, the commander of Silvermoon's defenses. While the ranger-general leads both the military and the Farstriders, the army that defends Quel'Thalas is a separate entity from the elven ranger corps, whose small numbers would in any case make it impossible for them to wage war. The army draws upon elements of the distinguished military orders that comprise the Silvermoon Court, each of which has their own chain of command, but in general military matters, even the Magisters and Blood Knights act as subordinates to the ranger-general. The Three Shields is a set of three islands off the northeastern shore of Isle of Dorn. A Dragon Glyph is found at atop the highest peak of the middle island. Tuyuki is a dead tuskarr located in Brackenhide Brambles in the Azure Span who planned to set sail to Northrend to reconnect with their kin. She went with her fellow tuskarr to a hunt, but was killed by the Brackenhide gnolls. When the adventurer found her body and called upon her spirit, instead of crossing over Tuyuki resolved to empower Brena's Totem to fight against the decay-corrupted gnolls. Brena then summoned her to help destroy the Twisted Ancient, after which Brena thanked her and released all the spirits to be with Karkut.

.]] The Vault of Tyr is a titan-forged vault that holds the Discs of Tyr and serves as the last section of Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr. The Vault is entered from the Earthworks in the southeast and initially contain only earthen and stone golems. However, once players have gotten about halfway to the end, they are intercepted by Chrono-Lord Deios, who summons in infinite dragonflight forces that kill the titan-forged in the rest of the vault with time magic. Deios himself is fought in the last room of the Vault, after he successfully causes the Discs of Tyr to be lost to time. The first area used to be the Hall of the Crafters.

Vembrion was the one-eyed seneschal of the Obsidian Guard. He and his forces secured the scene of a mortal village that had been destroyed in an attack by a rogue black dragon, and Neltharion ordered him to bring all evidence directly to him instead of Alexstrasza so that the black dragonflight could handle the affair internally. Vembrion and his Obsidian Guard were left to hold the Obsidian Citadel on their own when Neltharion summoned the rest of the military forces at the Citadel to Valdrakken in preparation for the Primalist assault.

Venom? More Like Get 'Em is the second in a series of grindy quests to obtain Siesbarg (mount) as a flying mount. To begin, level players should defeat Tka'ktath, on a floating platform above the Salien Gutters in Azj-Kahet, and loot a Vial of Tka'ktath's Blood. Then, collect 1,500 Nerubian Chitin (Khaz Algar) from enemies in Khaz Algar for Those Are Chitin Words. For this quest, Shalba wants 1,000 Nerubian Venom, specifically from nerubian enemies. Many of the same sources from the previous quest will suffice for this quest. Rare spawns Rhak'ik and Khak'ik on patrol of the Silken Path near drop 10-12 venom. Enemies in the City of Threads dungeon are also a good source.

The Vindicators are a military organization of draenei vindicators, great holy warriors of the Light, who have sworn to protect their people since their exile from Argus. Under the command of High Vindicator Akama, they defended their people from the dark forces that lurked in Draenor. When the Burning Legion found the planet, the Vindicators were the first line of defense to prevent the total genocide of the draenei by the Orcish Horde, sacrificing their lives in the siege of Shattrath City to give the refugees a chance to escape to Zangarmarsh. It is unknown if the organization is still active.

The War of Light and Shadow is a final, apocalyptic conflict between the Light and the Void taking place on Azeroth. Different cultures have had different interpretations of it. Neither Xe'ra nor Prophet Velen's visions seem to have (yet) come to pass, whereas some Hallowfall Arathi believe Renilash started during the war in Khaz Algar. The true conflict seemingly arrived when Xal'atath usurped the power of the Void lord Dimensius and assembled the Devouring Host to invade Azeroth. Battles also took place in the Maw, the Devouring Host's base of operations in the Voidstorm, and other planets in the Great Dark Beyond such as Val and Naigtal.

The war for Stratholme was a conflict between the Argent Crusade, the Risen, and the Scourge for control of Stratholme. The offensive was planned by Crusade Commander Eligor Dawnbringer, with the objective of securing the Scarlet Bastion in the western district and Alonsus Chapel in the eastern district, for the purpose of cleansing the undead across the burning City. The Crusade's efforts were opposed by the nathrezim Balnazzar, who sought a powerful center for his new unholy empire, and by Lord Aurius Rivendare, who had succeeded his father as the leader of the Scourge in the Western Plaguelands. With the aid of adventurers, the Argent Crusade ultimately emerged victorious from the campaig

Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom (abbreviated as FK) is an expansion pack for Warcraft III: Reforged. Released on 12 September 2026 following its reveal at BlizzCon 2026 the same day, it explores the last days of Lordaeron and details the events that lead to the establishment of the Undercity, serving as a direct narrative precursor to the events of World of Warcraft. The expansion follows the story of Garek Bandarion, a lieutenant in Lordaeron's city guard and later an undead warrior through the beginning of the Forsaken faction's creation. Notably, it brings several formerly minor non-player characters from the MMO into prominent campaign figures, such as Dark Ranger Anya and Leonid

Warlord Grazla was the Warlord of the Dark Horde by the time of the War of Light and Shadow. Her lieutenants were Nagosh the Scarred and Mar'kag, and all three held pieces of the shattered Shield of Turalyon. Grazla held tightly to her fragment under the belief that it contained significant power even while broken. In time Arator Windrunner, Alonsus Faol, and the Sons of Lothar journeyed to the Burning Steppes to retrieve the shield's pieces, and clashed with the Dark Horde. Grazla was ultimately slain, with her dying words expressing her belief that the Dark Horde shall never be stopped.

It was called many things at first, but soon all came to know it as simply the "Wasting". WoW Remix (also called Timerunning) is a special event where players can replay an old expansion in a fresh, faster way. The infinite dragonflight sends newly created characters, known as Timerunners, back in time to experience the story again but with powerful gear, quicker leveling, and with old and new rewards. There are a total of three events thus far: * WoW Remix: Mists of Pandaria * WoW Remix: Legion * WoW Remix: Wrath of the Lich King

Zul'jan ( ) was a forest troll of Zul'Aman, the grandson of Zul'jin and the adviser to his sister Zul'jarra, chieftain of the Amani trolls. Unlike his sister Zul'jarra, he is not a warrior, preferring to talk his way through problems. He distrusts the loa because, regardless of the actions of Zul'jin, they still abandoned his people and his family. He worries that prioritizing the loa without focusing on the strength of the Amani will lead to their people being shattered again. He thought with the lightwood that they would be able to take back their ancestral lands after defeating the Twilight's Blade.
